# Sir Claude

> A free, local dashboard for managing every Claude Code project on your machine, rendered as a browser-based medieval kingdom.

Sir Claude is an npm package (`npx sir-claude`) that starts a small local web server (Fastify, bound to 127.0.0.1 only) with an Angular/three.js UI. It scans the project folders you register and shows them as a 3D kingdom: folders are buildings, running Claude Code sessions are knights, and a voice-enabled AI character narrates and can run commands for you. No account or cloud service is involved — it only reads Claude Code's own local files and uses your own `claude` CLI login.

Requirements: Node.js 22.12 or newer and the Claude Code CLI, already logged in. macOS is the main supported platform.

The app itself is free to run. Its source code is closed; people who want GitHub access to the source can request it (see Contact below).

## Key pages

- [Home / full feature tour](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/): hero, kingdom overview, feature-by-feature tour, how it works, install instructions, and membership/contact info.
- [Kingdom & world](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#kingdom): the 3D map view of registered projects.
- [Projects & Chat](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#projects): per-project page with commands, Claude chat history, and IDE/terminal shortcuts.
- [Automation](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#automation): commands, reusable "spells", scheduled jobs, and AI-assisted ("Conjure") spell/job creation.
- [Terminal](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#terminal): a real per-project shell in the browser.
- [Quest Board](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#quests): open Jira tickets shown as quests.
- [Processes](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#processes): every running or waiting Claude chat and shell in one list.
- [Insight](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#insight): git status, file search, Claude usage limits, and system load.
- [Insights](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#insights): cost and time spent per day, project, and model.
- [Voice & Telegram](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#voice): offline voice control and Telegram bot integration.
- [Proving Grounds](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#proving-grounds): benchmark prompts across Claude, GPT, Gemini, and other LLMs.
- [The Chronicle](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#chronicle): an illustrated, in-character changelog of the project's development.
- [How it works](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#how): architecture (Fastify server, Angular/three.js UI, Claude Code CLI) and tech stack.
- [Run it](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#install): install and run instructions (`npx sir-claude`).
- [Membership / contact](https://bc3.github.io/sir-claude-website/#membership): how to request source access or get in touch.

## Facts

- Product: Sir Claude, a local dashboard for Claude Code projects.
- Distribution: npm package `sir-claude`, run with `npx sir-claude` (default http://localhost:4300).
- Cost to run: free.
- Source code: closed; access for members by request.
- Platform: macOS primary; requires Node.js 22.12+ and the Claude Code CLI.
- Network: binds to 127.0.0.1 only; no cloud account.
- Built by: Ben Croughs, using Claude Code.
- Contact: GitHub https://github.com/bc3, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/sirclaude.dev/, email ben.croughs@telenet.be.
